name: Landhaus Andrä
beschreibung: Landhaus Andrä welcomes holidaymakers to a quiet, sunlit neighborhood in the picturesque village of Thiersee in Tyrol's lower Inn Valley. This traditional guest residence combines sincere family hospitality with alpine coziness, featuring comfortably appointed rooms and apartments with private balconies framing the mountain vistas. A well-manicured garden with a sunbathing lawn provides a peaceful retreat after outdoor adventures. Located close to Lake Thiersee, guests enjoy a wide range of activities including summer lake swimming, hiking in the Kaisergebirge, and relaxed winter sports across local slopes.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional alpine holiday country house in Thiersee offering gardens, mountain views, and quiet relaxation.
